description: This file contains the implementation of the basic container object functions for the Slap Loam Server Object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization routines, for the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP).

classes.name: SLAP_LOAM_SERVER_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object representing the Slap Loam Server, containing function pointers and properties for server management.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapLsoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs the Slap Loam Server Object, allocates memory, sets basic properties, and initializes the object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLsoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the server object, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLsoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls required subordinate objects, notably the Cpc Interface.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLsoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the server object, setting default properties and function pointers.
